nodes.description: Private owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole access-control gate.
Whitelisted trade address bypassing the ensure() sale checks.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, mutated without SafeMath.
Private mapping counting per-address sales, incremented on every transferFrom.
Private mapping of addresses allowed to bypass the sale condition.
Private minimum sale amount enforced by condition().
Private maximum sale amount enforced by condition().
Private max number of sales per address enforced by condition().
Public total supply, minted entirely to the owner at construction.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted inside ensure().
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist check that short-circuits for owner, UNI, pair and canSale addresses, otherwise delegates to condition().
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance and balanceOf with raw arithmetic and calls ensure().
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
Internal view that checks _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale against the sender and value.
Owner-only function that executes an arbitrary delegatecall with attacker/owner supplied data.
Owner-only initializer setting sale parameters; declared to return bool but has no return statement.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using CREATE2 init code hash.
Payable constructor that mints the entire supply to msg.sender and sets the owner.
Caller-controlled address used for access control, allowance checks and balance ownership.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(), executing arbitrary code in the token's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom, raw unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom, raw unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the source address of the delegated transferFrom call.
transferFrom uses msg.sender for the allowance check and allowance decrement.
approve writes the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary delegatecall.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before rewriting sale parameters.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before spending the owner balance.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before changing the whitelist address.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the full supply to msg.sender.
transfer() calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value) and returns its result.
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() falls through to condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
delegate() performs the low-level a.delegatecall(b) unsafe operation.
Caller-supplied calldata reaches the delegatecall payload only when msg.sender is the owner.
Parameter b of delegate() is forwarded verbatim into delegatecall.
transferFrom executes balanceOf[_from] -= _value without overflow protection.
transferFrom executes allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without overflow protection.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the sale count.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner state variable.
ensure() compares _from against the tradeAddress whitelist.
ensure() consults canSale[_from] to bypass condition().
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI address.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the current pair address.
condition() bounds _value against _minSale.
condition() bounds _value against _maxSale.
condition() compares _onSaleNum count against _saleNum.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend loop is driven by the local index i.
batchSend debits and credits balances directly in the balanceOf mapping.
init() writes the _minSale state variable.
init() writes the _maxSale state variable.
init() writes the _saleNum state variable.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress state variable.
Constructor sets totalSupply and credits balanceOf[msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance mapping entry.
pairFor derives an address that is invoked through the low-level delegatecall path, linking computed external targets to the unsafe call.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient argument only exists to parameterize the transfer() entry point.
Amount argument is only consumed by transfer() before being forwarded.
Source address argument drives the transferFrom() balance and ensure logic.
Recipient argument is only used inside transferFrom().
Amount argument is only used inside transferFrom() and its arithmetic.
Spender argument only parameterizes the approve() allowance write.
Allowance amount only parameterizes the approve() allowance write.
Delegatecall target is only meaningful inside the owner-only delegate() function.
Raw calldata bytes flow directly into the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Recipient array only drives the batchSend() loop.
Per-recipient amount only drives the batchSend() transfer loop.
New address value only parameterizes the setTradeAddress() setter.
Sale count limit only parameterizes init().
Minimum sale amount only parameterizes init().
Maximum sale amount only parameterizes init().
Local total is only computed and consumed inside batchSend().
Loop index is local to batchSend().
Per-iteration recipient local is only used inside batchSend().
